sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Stone spires break through the treeline, each holding a small flame. One light westward burns weaker than the rest.

sections.body: Use the map as the visual anchor for the official Relay hook. Do not make it playable this session.

items: The Relay Spire is a door left open, not an encounter.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is a vista, not a dungeon. The weak light is the hook; the map is what she can give you later."
